title: apium montanum
intro: Apium montanum, commonly known as mountain celery or wild celery, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The health benefits of Apium montanum include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a digestive aid, a treatment for respiratory issues, and a remedy for skin problems, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Apium montanum include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
